I've tried to replicate without success so far. Could you try upgrading all the packages:

> update.packages()
> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com")

If it persists, please send version information:

> rattleInfo()


Regards,
Graham



On 3 December 2012 12:27, hari <hari...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello
I was following along the weather data example from the "DataMining with Rattle and R" book. When I tried to get a Box Plot for "Sunshine" I got the following error message and a blank graphics window.

Error in +ggtitle("Distribution of Sunshine") :
  invalid argument to unary operator

I updated all packages. I even installed the latest version of R (2.15.2). Previously I was using 2.15.1.

I am wondering what I am doing wrong. Any help is appreciated greatly. Thanks in advance.

Best regards
Hari
